warning: Historical precedents and attributed studies only. Not live legal advice, current 2026 state-law status, or proof of discriminatory intent or causation.

records.title: Shelby County v. Holder
records.finding: Supreme Court invalidated the Voting Rights Act Section 4(b) coverage formula, making it inoperative for ordinary Section 5 preclearance.

records.title: Rucho v. Common Cause
records.finding: Federal partisan gerrymandering claims are nonjusticiable political questions under the federal Constitution.

records.title: Crawford v. Marion County Election Board
records.finding: The Supreme Court upheld Indiana's specific photo-identification framework against the facial challenge presented.

records.title: Husted v. A. Philip Randolph Institute
records.finding: The Supreme Court upheld the specific Ohio notice-and-wait voter-list maintenance procedure under federal law.

records.title: Brnovich v. Democratic National Committee
records.finding: The Supreme Court rejected Section 2 challenges to Arizona's specific out-of-precinct ballot and third-party collection rules.

records.title: Allen v. Milligan
records.finding: The Supreme Court affirmed the district court's application of Voting Rights Act Section 2 to Alabama's congressional map.

records.title: Locked Out 2020
records.finding: Historical estimate of approximately 5.17 million people disenfranchised due to a felony conviction; not a 2026 count.

records.title: Democracy Diverted
records.finding: Historical study reported 750 Texas polling-place closures and 214 fewer Georgia polling sites within its studied period and jurisdictional coverage; not current totals.

records.title: Growing Racial Disparities in Voter Turnout, 2008–2022
records.finding: The authors estimate 9.3 million additional voters in 2020 under a hypothetical equal-racial-turnout-rate scenario; counterfactual, not observed suppressed votes.
